name: revit-model-mcp
description: For people reviewing or automating Revit models with an AI client: read a live Revit model through MCP, read-only by default, and act in it only when two explicit gates are on. Requires uv on the client PATH: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/.
long_description: Actions are opt-in and require both the client setting and the workstation allow-write file. The Revit add-in must be installed separately on Windows. macOS and Linux clients connect to a remote Windows workstation.

args: import os; os.environ.update({key: '1' if os.environ.get(key, default).lower() in ('true', '1') else '0' for key, default in (('REVIT_MCP_REDACT_PATHS', 'true'), ('REVIT_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE', 'false'))}); from revit_model_mcp.server import main; main()

tools.name: revit_document_info
tools.description: Read document, levels, area schemes and worksets.

tools.name: revit_list_catalog
tools.description: Discover valid category, family, view and parameter names.

tools.name: revit_aggregate_elements
tools.description: Group by one or two fields; return counts and optional sum/average.

tools.name: revit_query_elements
tools.description: Read a page of matching elements.

tools.name: revit_list_views
tools.description: Find views in the active document.

tools.name: revit_view_summary
tools.description: Read view metadata and category counts.

tools.name: revit_export_view
tools.description: Download a PNG; pixel_size is 1-4000 pixels on the fitted image dimension.

tools.name: revit_view_elements
tools.description: Read a page of elements in a view.

tools.name: revit_element_details
tools.description: Read instance/type parameters and geometry by unitless Revit ID.

tools.name: revit_view_warnings
tools.description: Read warnings involving elements in a view.

tools.name: revit_list_warnings
tools.description: Group warnings or inspect a specific warning group.

tools.name: revit_model_health
tools.description: Read model quality counts and top warnings before hand-over.

tools.name: revit_links_status
tools.description: Read RVT, CAD and image status, paths and instance counts.

tools.name: revit_shared_coordinates
tools.description: Read base/survey points, sites and link transforms in mm and degrees.

tools.name: revit_parameter_fill_check
tools.description: Count filled, empty and missing values; sample unitless element IDs.

REVIT_MCP_HOST.title: Workstation host
REVIT_MCP_HOST.description: Use local on the Windows Revit workstation, ssh:<alias> for a configured SSH host, or http://host:port (https://host:port with a TLS proxy) for HTTP. macOS and Linux require a remote Windows workstation. Prefer a loopback tunnel for HTTP.

REVIT_MCP_REDACT_PATHS.title: Redact model paths
REVIT_MCP_REDACT_PATHS.description: Hide directories in response path fields. Model names, parameter values, errors and exported image localPath values remain visible.

REVIT_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE.title: Allow actions (dangerous)
REVIT_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE.description: Dangerous: enables actions that can change the Revit model. Also requires the workstation allow-write file. Leave disabled for read-only use.

REVIT_MCP_TOKEN.title: HTTP bearer token
REVIT_MCP_TOKEN.description: Required only for HTTP or HTTPS. Use the token from the workstation settings.json. Leave empty for local or SSH.
